title: CapacityAnalysisResult
description: HX-241 channel capacity analysis results. Computes Shannon capacity, spectral efficiency, and distinguishable wave state counts from XPOCK's wave structure analysis and ENGINES' information theory engine.

shannon_capacity_bps.description: Shannon channel capacity C = B * log2(1 + SNR) in bits per second

spectral_efficiency_bps_hz.description: Spectral efficiency in bits per second per Hz

usable_capacity_bps.description: Usable capacity after forward error correction overhead

distinguishable_states.description: Number of distinguishable wave states (from JS divergence analysis)

bits_per_symbol.description: Bits encodable per wave symbol: log2(distinguishable_states)

symbols_per_second.description: Symbol rate (baud) estimate, typically equal to bandwidth for passband

net_information_rate_bps.description: Net information rate after all overheads

min_js_divergence.description: Minimum Jensen-Shannon divergence between any pair of wave states

avg_js_divergence.description: Average Jensen-Shannon divergence between wave state pairs

hx241_mapping.rust_type: Used for hx-sim benchmark configuration and session dimensioning
hx241_mapping.purpose: Dimension HX-241 sessions, flow control windows, and congestion control parameters
hx241_mapping.invariant: Capacity estimates are mathematical models; actual achievable rates depend on implementation
